subject.title: refactor(agents): make API registry ownership lifecycle-local

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this lifecycle-local API registry boundary, including snapshotting published Plugin SDK providers at `ModelRegistry` lifecycle refresh rather than routing hot paths through the mutable process-default registry?
rationale: This is a broad core ownership and compatibility decision across provider registration, session refresh, auth-adjacent routing, and the shipped Plugin SDK facade; source inspection can establish coherence but cannot choose the intended permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle boundary after proof
options.body: Confirm the SDK publication and refresh semantics are the intended supported contract, then require a redacted real runtime isolation proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep lifecycle-local stream routing but preserve a more explicit compatibility bridge for supported provider registrations if maintainers require dynamic process-default publication.

options.title: Pause for ownership design
options.body: Hold the PR if the repository does not yet want a per-`ModelRegistry` registry lifecycle as the canonical provider-routing owner.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle boundary after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the SDK publication and refresh semantics are the intended supported contract, then require a redacted real runtime isolation proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the proposed lifecycle boundary and its final integration commits.
